supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible extension beyond the outer ocular corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked contrast with a significantly lighter muzzle area against dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: visible 2D thickness with a distinct light-colored lower margin

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: deep notch or missing tissue in the superior quadrant of the left ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: severe structural notch or deformity on the upper portion of the left ear
other_distinctive_markers: extensive white/grey hair coverage on the chin and lower muzzle
